title: Rank-zero specialization agrees with integration for an etale section
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N>0 an integer with NA=0, and g:V→S a compactifiable separated quasi-compact etale map between Noetherian schemes. Let s:S→V be a closed section with s≫g=id, let d be a natural number with hd:d=0, supply Geometry d g s of [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation], and assume N is invertible in Γ(S,top). Use the line, zeroLineIso, normalSectionMap and orientation factors of [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps, def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data] and graph-normalized comparison family C of [def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates]. For every actual Rees family isomorphism kappa normalized at one, and every Cartesian cone-to-bundle square sq, specialization A g s kappa equals sectionCoordinates(C,g,s) followed by zeroLineIso.inv, bundleSectionAdjoint and normalSectionMap(sq). The assertion has no smooth orientation alpha and no diagonal base-change factor.

proof.text: Substitute hd:d=0. Base change of the smooth rank-zero deformation projection makes the normal projection smooth of dimension zero, hence etale; separatedness is preserved by the same Cartesian square. Cancel postcomposition with the normal-section coordinate isomorphism. Apply the specialization-coordinate identity and the rank-zero bundle/cone coordinate identity, then cancel zeroLineIso.inv against its hom.

theorem finiteEtaleSectionIntegration
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian S]
    (g : V ⟶ S) [HasCompactification g] [QuasiCompact g] [IsSeparated g] [Etale g]
    (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 0) [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g s]
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (C : FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons A)
    (hC : FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized A C)
    (kappa : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g s ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g s))
    (hKappa : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g s hs kappa)
    (sq : IsPullback
      (reesConeComparison s ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso d g s).hom
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1)) (𝟙 S)) :
    NoetherianSectionSpecialization.specialization A g s kappa =
      (finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C g s).hom ≫ (zeroLineIso A N hA S d hd).inv ≫
        FiniteRingSectionDeformation.bundleSectionAdjoint N hN A hA S hS d
          (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1) ≫ normalSectionMap A d g s hs sq
